description: Check a signed REGULARUS safety report by the verification number printed below the signature and in the footer (16 characters, e.g. K7Q2-9XMV-3HPD-RW4T, also as QR code). Returns product and version as in the report, signing date, assessor with qualification, status (valid, superseded by a newer version, or withdrawn) and the SHA-256 hash of the PDF file. A number that is not found means the report does not come from REGULARUS. The sample number MUSTER returns an example.

lang.description: Language of the verification page link (default de).

number.description: Verification number from the report, with or without hyphens.

name: verify_report
title: Verify a safety report
